title: study-guide design config
description: One design. Resolved as: named preset library, overridden by the repo default, overridden by a per-guide config. Any object a partial config supplies is deep-merged key-by-key over the layer beneath; a key it omits keeps the lower layer's value.

name.description: Preset name. Present in the library, absent in a per-guide config.

basedOn.description: Name of the library preset this config starts from. Absent in library presets themselves.

themes.description: Which themes the build emits. [dark] -> one dark PDF. [light] -> one light PDF. Both -> both PDFs. Nothing else is ever produced.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: name a shipped light preset instead of listing tokens.

texture.description: Grain on top of the shape. 'focused' means the density patch is active.

patch.description: The density patch: grain is boosted inside a radius around a point. Replaces the old centre/corner/top/off-canvas position menu.

x.description: Point x as a fraction of page width. 0 = left edge.

y.description: Point y as a fraction of page height. 0 = top edge.

radius.description: Reach of the boost as a fraction of the shorter page side. Tight masks are what make the patch visible; wide ones read as nothing.

strength.description: How much denser the grain is at the centre, as a multiple of the surrounding field.

layout.description: Scales rhythm and type together. Body text is floored around 9pt even in compact.

fonts.description: Role mapping. Weight is fixed per role (see the bundled manifest); only family and size are chosen. 'label' controls every small label — unit tag, callout head, table header, caption, footer — and defaults to the bundled serif italic. It is not a free choice: labels are serif italic, sentence case, untracked.

randomiser.description: Which axes the curated randomiser is allowed to vary. A locked axis keeps its current value.

source.description: 'bundled' ships with the skill and is reproducible anywhere. 'local' names a family installed on this machine; the PDF only matches on machines that have it.

family.description: Bundled family name (e.g. 'Poppins') or an installed family name (e.g. 'Cascadia Mono').

weight.description: Only meaningful for a local family, whose available weights are enumerated at pick time. Bundled roles ignore this and use their fixed weight.

size.description: Base size in points for the role; the layout preset scales it.

colour.description: Any CSS colour except color-mix() and color(from ...), which WeasyPrint rejects. The editor precomputes any mix at generation time.

base.description: Page background, flat beneath the gradient.

gradient.description: Stops for the linear shape; the mesh and vignette shapes derive their layers from the same stops.

faint.description: Footnotes, timestamps. Must clear 4.5:1 on the base.

accent.description: The one accent: kickers, callout rules, links.

ruleStrong.description: Stronger hairlines: card borders, header rules. Derived from a white/black wash when omitted.

accentSoft.description: The accent at ~32% for the algorithm card's left edge and the pill outline. Derived from accent when omitted.

warn.description: Note-callout label. Amber. Callouts only, never general text.

code.description: The code card is the one card that inverts: dark-on-light grounds carry a dark code card.

selection.description: Text-selection ground inside code blocks. Derived from accent when omitted.
